Professional Summary
Front-end focused developer with hands-on experience building scalable web applications using Angular and TypeScript. Proven track record delivering UI features, improving test coverage, and collaborating across teams to deploy production releases. Notice period: 15 days.

Technical Skills
Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, HTML, Jest, NodeJS, Jira

Work Experience

Angular Developer, Zoho (May 2025 - Present)
- Implemented dynamic form and dashboard components using Angular and HTML, improving user task completion rate by introducing responsive layouts and accessibility attributes.
- Developed RxJS-based data streams to optimize real-time updates, reducing perceived latency on live views and decreasing redundant API calls.
- Wrote and maintained Jest unit tests for critical UI modules, increasing component test coverage and catching regressions before release.
- Collaborated with product and QA via Jira to triage and resolve high-priority issues, enabling two on-time product iterations.

Node.js Developer, Cognizant (Mar 2022 - Apr 2025)
- Built backend microservices with NodeJS and TypeScript to support frontend features, delivering stable APIs consumed by web clients.
- Implemented input validation and error handling to improve API reliability and reduce production incidents.
- Integrated services with frontend teams using clear API contracts and documentation tracked in Jira, accelerating cross-team feature delivery.
- Created unit tests and lightweight integration checks to validate endpoints and support safe deployments.
